info.name: |CFF6DCFF6Ruined Temple TD|r v.1.04
info.author: Antsu
info.description: |CFF6DCFF6An oldschool TD mixed with new features. Creeps are trying to enter a portal inside a ruined temple. Build towers and train soldiers to walls to defeat them. Creeps must destroy a gate before they can enter the temple.|r

fields.aub1@1: Calls down a storm of lightning to strike enemy units. Lasts 20 seconds.
Allows this tower to fire multiple targets at the same time. 3 targets maximum.
Allows this tower to fire multiple targets at the same time. 6 targets maximum.
Sells this tower for 75% of the total cost of this tower.
Speeds up nearby towers by 33%.
Adds a poison damage to attack dealing 7 damage to target per second for 12 seconds.
Shredder Spear bounces to a nearby unit after hitting the main target. Can hit 3 targets.
Adds a poison damage to attack dealing 15 damage to target per second for 18 seconds and slowing it's movement speed by 30%.
Adds 10 bonus fire damage to an attack.
Adds a poison damage to attack dealing 35 damage to target per second for 30 seconds and slowing it's movement speed by 40%.
Shuriken bounces to a nearby unit after hitting the main target. Can hit 4 targets.
Every missile slows target unit by 50%. Lasts for 8 seconds.
Speeds up nearby towers by 50%.
Every missile slows target unit by 60%. Lasts for 12 seconds.
Repairs the main gate back to it's full hitpoints.
Enchances nearby units' weapons to increase their damage by 50%.
Drains mana of an enemy unit.
Gives 1 mana to all nearby units.
Every missile slows target unit by 75%. Lasts for 18 seconds.
Gives 50% chance to stun unit for 3 seconds and deal 50 bonus damage.
By flying you can move faster and fly over the towers and walls. You may not build from the air, but you can complete half built towers.
fields.auu1@1: Land to be able to build towers.

fields.aub1@1: Gives 50% chance to freeze a unit for 1.20 seconds.
Adds a poison damage to attack dealing 120 damage to target for the rest of it's life and slowing it by 50%.
Slows target unit's attack speed by 60% and deals 10 damage to it per second. Lasts 8 seconds.
Throws gold coins at a targeted enemy, stunning it for 8 seconds. The coins are directly taken from your gold stock. Use only in emergencies.

strings.TRIGSTR_402:
-This is a team game, so work together.
|CFF6DCFF6-Find an optimal firing place for every tower you build. Build only on places where creeps pass by more than once.|r
-Upgrade your towers and your tech when you are able to.
|CFF6DCFF6-Building and upgrading towers can unlock new towers.|r
-You can build on most doodads, including trees. However there are few unbuildable spots.
|CFF6DCFF6-Towers automatically shoot stupidly. Guide them to shoot better.|r
-Some towers work better on some waves than others.
|CFF6DCFF6-A well placed Aura Tower can boost 8 towers.|r
-Hotkeys are placed so, that their position in the build menu matches the position of the hotkey on the keyboard.
